description: Output-quality (example-execution) smoke for blueprint-flow: verify the skill routes to the right MCP tool and produces the right output shape for structure analysis, execution-flow tracing, and input-to-action tracing. Added by Issue #20378 to close the trigger-only gap and refreshed by Issue #25676 with assets verified in the canonical Lyra 5.7 project. Cases are asset-gated (Issue #19514): where the named project asset is absent they SKIP rather than pass-lenient, so an offline/CI run is never a false-red and a SKIP can never mask a real routing failure (no-mask #14675).

cases._precondition_rationale: Issues #20378/#25676: the structure-analysis case reads a real Blueprint via ue_manage_blueprint(get_structure). B_Hero_Default is verified in the canonical Lyra 5.7 project, and the tool_usage assertion is meaningful only when it is declared present via EVAL_PROJECT_ASSETS/--project-assets. Absent -> SKIP (no project-version false-red; a SKIP cannot mask a real routing failure, no-mask #14675).

Issues #20378/#25676: the execution-tracing case traces a real Blueprint via ue_trace_execution(trace_execution_flow). The llm_judge strictly requires a real step-by-step chain, so it may only run when the canonical Lyra 5.7 fixture B_Hero_Default is declared present; otherwise SKIP (no-mask #14675).

assertions.description: Should show an execution chain / flow

assertions.criteria: Does the response trace the Blueprint's execution flow as an ordered chain of nodes/steps (entry point through function calls), rather than only describing the Blueprint statically?

cases._precondition_rationale: Issues #20378/#25676: the input-to-action case resolves a hardware key to its InputAction chain. Gated on IA_Jump because SpaceBar -> IA_Jump is verified in the canonical Lyra 5.7 project; absent -> SKIP. tool_usage_any accepts EITHER routing the skill documents: Method B ue_run_workflow(input-to-action) or Method A ue_trace_execution(trace_from_input) — asserting one specific tool would false-fail the other valid path.

assertions.description: Input-to-action should route via ue_run_workflow(input-to-action) or ue_trace_execution(trace_from_input)
Should identify the concrete physical input key
Should state the SpaceBar-to-IA_Jump mapping relationship, not merely mention generic input/action terms
